description: Watch for changes to Settings resources.

address.description: The address where notifications are delivered for this channel.
address.human_parameter_description: The URL where notifications should be sent. Provide your publicly reachable webhook endpoint.
address.title: Address

expiration.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds specifying when the API should stop sending notifications for this channel.
expiration.human_parameter_description: Optional timestamp (in milliseconds) when this notification channel should expire and stop sending updates.
expiration.title: Expiration

id.description: A UUID or similar unique string that identifies this channel.
id.human_parameter_description: A unique identifier you assign to this notification channel. Choose any string that helps you recognize or manage it later.
id.title: Id

params.description: Additional parameters controlling delivery channel behavior.
params.human_parameter_description: Optional settings that control how the channel behaves, such as how long it should stay active.

ttl.description: The time-to-live in seconds for the notification channel. Default is 604800 seconds.
ttl.title: Ttl

params.title: SettingsWatchRequestParams

token.description: An arbitrary string delivered to the target address with each notification delivered over this channel.
token.human_parameter_description: An optional secret string included with each notification so you can verify the requests came from this channel.
token.title: Token

type.description: The type of delivery mechanism used for this channel. Must be "web_hook".
type.human_parameter_description: How you want to receive notifications. Must be 'web_hook' to get HTTP callbacks to your endpoint.
type.title: Type

name: settings_watch

display_url.description: URL to view this resource in the Google Calendar web interface. Notification channels have no web UI, so this is always None.
display_url.title: Display Url

expiration.description: Optional. Date and time of notification channel expiration, expressed as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Some responses may return a 13-digit string.
expiration.title: Expiration

id.description: A client-defined unique identifier (UUID or similar) that identifies this channel.
id.title: Id

kind.description: Identifies this as a notification channel used to watch for changes to a resource. Always "api#channel".
kind.title: Kind

resourceId.description: An opaque ID that identifies the resource being watched on this channel. Stable across different API versions.
resourceId.title: Resource Id

resourceUri.description: A version-specific identifier (canonical URI) for the watched resource.
resourceUri.title: Resource Uri

token.description: Optional. An arbitrary string delivered to the target address with each notification delivered over this channel. Commonly used to verify notifications by matching it to a value stored by the application.
token.title: Token
